all.label: FSK securities class-action lead-plaintiff deadline
all.why: Confirms the FSK discount is legacy/governance-driven, not AI -- the basis of the S3' control-set exclusion (amendment A1).

all.label: Q2-2026 BDC NAV re-card
all.why: Re-card the eight BDC NAVs from Q2 results into BDC_NAV; S3' must compare close to REPORTED NAV, never estimated.

all.label: Signal-semantics freeze
all.why: No semantic amendments to S1-S4 after this date, so the Q4 adjudication scores a spec fixed well before the data arrived (ROADMAP doctrine).

all.label: Google -> SpaceX compute contract revenue start
all.why: ~$920M/month begins; the first of the SpaceX adjacency contracts to go live.

all.label: Q3-2026 BDC NAV re-card
all.why: Re-card BDC NAVs from Q3 results; last re-card before the Q4 adjudication.

all.label: 2026-Q4 TIMING-KILL adjudication
all.why: The engine's registered predictions are scored -- the first calibration datum for whether the apparatus can be trusted. The one date that is not optional.

all.label: SpaceX contract termination window opens (90-day notice)
all.why: First quarter in which the ~$26B/yr SpaceX compute run-rate is economically at-will; renewal/termination behaviour is the best single test of the headline backlog.

all.label: Q4-2026 BDC NAV re-card
all.why: Re-card BDC NAVs from full-year results.

all.label: Maturity wall 2030-2033 begins
all.why: 88% of carded maturities ($36.6B of $41.7B) stack 2030-33 on collateral at/past GPU economic life -- the refinancing-vs-collateral-age terminal test.

all.label: CoreWeave-OpenAI commitment expiry
all.why: The contract servicing the maturity wall is itself up for renewal as the wall peaks -- backlog quality becomes terminal.
